title: Harness Launch Wrapper Config
description: Configuration file for hlw CLI tool

executable.description: Path or name of the executable to run

args.description: Default command-line arguments to pass to the executable

envVars.description: Environment variables to inject into the subprocess. A value may contain {{endpoint}}, replaced by the harness's endpoint, or {{env:NAME}}, replaced by the value of NAME in the process environment - so a base URL or a secret need not be stored here. An entry whose placeholder cannot be resolved is not set.

endpoint.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible server. The model list is fetched from <endpoint>/v1/models. A trailing /v1 is accepted and not duplicated.

modelURL.description: Full URL of the model list, for servers that do not serve it at /v1/models. Overrides endpoint when both are set.

modelEnvVars.description: Environment variables set to the selected model id. Use for agents that take their model through the environment (e.g. Claude Code's ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL).

modelArgs.description: Arguments appended after args. {{model}} is replaced by the selected model id and {{contextWindow}} by its context window in tokens when the endpoint reports one. An argument whose placeholder has no value is dropped whole, so write flag and value as a single token (--config=key={{contextWindow}}).

modelAuthToken.description: Bearer token sent when fetching the model list. Supports {{env:NAME}} so the secret can live in the environment rather than this file. Omitted means the request is sent unauthenticated - there is no implicit token lookup.
